sources.citation: Rolls VB-Series LFP Drop-In Battery Operating Manual, 2026/02 (https://rollsbattery.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Rolls-VB-Series-LFP-Drop-In-Battery-Operating-Manual.pdf)

transport: Bluetooth LE to the Rolls LFP Connect app only. No wired data port documented.

models.name: VB-Series LFP drop-in (model numbers not enumerated on the manuals index)

gotchas: OUT OF SCOPE FOR QUEBEC and recorded only so nobody researches it twice. The manual's first line is 'Note: Product is limited to Rolls distributors in the UK and European Union only.'
New line — manual published 2026/02, the most recent Rolls LFP document found. Same Bluetooth-only story as the R/G/S drop-ins; no protocol published.

If it ever reaches Canada, check whether it lands on rolls-lfp-drop-in rather than assuming — it has its own manual rather than being folded into the drop-in manual, which is itself a small signal that the firmware differs.
